hypothesis: The FURNISHER/INTERPHASE composition law is clearest when the visible material interface and executable structure are the same DOM object: hard-edged blocks occupy an ordered carrier; visible typed seams are executable links; FOLD literally wraps sibling DOM into a cassette; ENTER reveals the same nested implementation; SOURCE returns that structural DOM; and model fit remains distinct from physical contract fit.
replaces_head: unmerged ROOM / HTML SUBSTRATE 0.3 proposal; itself a correction of SPACE SCALE 0.2
corrections: SPACE SCALE 0.2 had useful typed fold/dock/run semantics but the generic canvas was rejected by direct user evaluation.
HTML SUBSTRATE 0.3 removed the hidden graph model but over-corrected into a conventional vertical document.
0.4 keeps DOM-as-program and gives it a material/cassette projection without introducing a second canonical graph.
laws: STRUCTURAL DOM = PROGRAM: the nested #program DOM is the composition the runtime interprets.
VISIBLE SEAM = EXECUTABLE EDGE: rel=next anchors are both readable links and the RUN route.
FOLD MUTATES STRUCTURE, NOT A SHADOW MODEL: contiguous sibling blocks are wrapped in a real DOM cassette; child ids survive.
CASSETTE CLOSED/OPEN = ABSTRACTION VISIBILITY: one object may be read as a block or its implementation.
TYPE KEY IS A WITNESS, NOT A STANDARD: deterministic seam bits expose type identity and may seed print/tactile/optical experiments, but no physical fit is implied.
NO STRICT HOMOICONICITY CLAIM: JavaScript still interprets behavior; the narrower claim is DOM-as-program / structural reflexivity.
RETURN PRESERVES STRUCTURAL DOM + TRACE + BINDING.
implemented: Hard-edge horizontal material rail; no freeform node canvas or wire spaghetti.
Current FURNISHER program is ordinary nested HTML details blocks and visible rel=next seams.
Deterministic five-bit seam keys rendered directly from declared type.
MARK → move → FOLD wraps the actual sibling DOM into a generated cassette and rewires the visible top-level route.
ENTER / BACK focuses the cassette implementation without replacing its identity.
RUN follows visible top-level seams; GROUP executes nested child blocks and records internal trace.
VERIFY includes an explicit predicted/measured/tolerance model binding and an independent contract-fit bit.
SOURCE edits/reapplies the structural #program DOM; transient focus/run classes are excluded.
RETURN emits program DOM, run trace, binding and interaction events.
Built-in browser selftest proves initial run, nested trace, binding fixture, generated fold, folded run, SOURCE preservation and RETURN schema.
boundaries: HTML+JavaScript is not strictly homoiconic in the Lisp sense.
Seam-key geometry is not a proven physical connector or encoding standard.
Model-fit does not establish buildability, structural safety or contract-fit.
SPACE SCALE 0.2 core remains donor/tested machinery but is not the current UI authority.
evidence_gate: Use 0.4 on one real configuration sequence. Pass only if typed adjacency + literal DOM folding makes the program easier to inspect, alter and re-enter than both a plain list and the 0.2 canvas. If not, keep the DOM law and demote the rail projection.
next_if_pass: Bind one cassette to a harmless physical witness (printed key, rail slot, panel/cassette arrangement, or measured HOUSE planning fixture) and record model-fit and physical contract-fit independently.
next_if_fail: Reduce to structural HTML + links; retain seam-key/fold mechanics only where they pay rent.
